body:
This happens to me also but just selecting a few files (three to six 200MB files) as individual files, not as a folder.

Usually it transfers the first two files in parallel, with the third and later files queued up, and then when the first and second files finish, the app hangs and requires a force-quit on both ends.

When I added a lot of files (actually just one folder), about 10k or 100k files, the app is busy and I could not do any thing. Even the data transfer is not start yet.

Is it possible to paginate the transfer list or give less details to prevent UI blocking?
I am sending from Android.  10 files (of 10GB in total) would trigger blank screen hanging as well

I stumbled across a symptom. I was about to send one 200MB file and forgot to start the send. When I remembered to start it, it failed too, not sending at all. So it appears that there is some kind of timeout even though LocalSend (iOS) was open and did not appear to be suspended. It is likely that it is the same timeout that causes a batch of files to fail after some files have transferred.
